patterns.note: Full-bleed hero images and large, impactful 3D renders are used as dominant visual elements to introduce sections and products.
Large, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings (Clashgrotesk Variable) are used for section titles, creating a strong visual hierarchy against smaller, regular-weight body text and mono-spaced labels.
A stark monochromatic palette of black, white, and dark grey dominates, with a very subtle, almost ethereal light blue accent used sparingly for interactive elements like CTA dots.
The main navigation bar transforms upon scroll, shrinking in height and gaining a solid white background to become a sticky header.
The hero image exhibits a subtle parallax effect, moving at a slower rate than the page content as the user scrolls down.
Product categories are presented in a three-column grid, each featuring a distinct image card with minimal text labels and a small item count.

technique_notes: Full-bleed hero images are used with a subtle dark overlay to ensure text readability, often featuring high-contrast, stylized photography with a futuristic aesthetic.
Content sections are introduced with large, impactful typography and often feature integrated 3D renders or abstract visual elements that break traditional grid layouts.
The primary navigation bar dynamically shrinks in height and gains a solid background color as the user scrolls down, becoming sticky at the top of the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings (~4-5x body) with smaller, regular-weight sans-serif for body text and very small, often uppercase, mono-spaced labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout for all elements, images, and interactive components.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy spacing around major sections and headings creates a sense of luxury and allows visuals to breathe, while product grids maintain a balanced density.

standout: This site distinguishes itself with a high-fashion, avant-garde aesthetic, blending stylized photography with prominent 3D renders and large, experimental typography. The stark monochromatic palette with subtle, futuristic accents creates a luxurious and almost art-gallery-like experience, moving beyond typical e-commerce layouts.
